detail.longDescription: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse from shopping in its store. I'm blind, and my AI agent is how I shop. It reads the listings, compares the options, and tells me what I'm buying before I buy it. When Amazon blocks my agent, it blocks me. I wrote about what this costs people like me, and what we can do about it. https:// taylorarndt.substack.com/p/if- you-block-my-ai-agent-you-block # AI # AIAgents # accessibility # blind # disability
